en.p: A sequence $\{a_n\}$ whose first term is a natural number satisfies, for every natural number $n$,

en.eq: a_{n+1}=\begin{cases} 2^{a_n} & (\text{if } a_n \text{ is odd}) \\ \dfrac{1}{2}a_n & (\text{if } a_n \text{ is even}) \end{cases}

en.p: What is the sum of all values of $a_1$ for which $a_6+a_7=3$? [4 points]
